item.tib: ri rgyal snang gnyan bsang mchod
item.coloph: de ltar ri rgyal snang brnyan gyi bsang mchod dga' bde dpal 'bar 'di ni/ rig 'dzin za rang me 'bar gyi rnam sprul me ston sur+ya d+ha dza dang / dge sbyongs gshen btsun smon lam rgyal mtshan/ nor ma lha dga' sku mched dang*/ rnga la bu 'dus sogs kyis yang du bskul la brten te/ kho bo rig 'dzin kun grol gsang ba rtsal gyis sbrul sgron zla'i gral tshes bzang por gdong mtsher lcogs sgar du 'phral mar bris pa dge'o//
